* without SCRIPT_INTERFACE, Qt 5.7 is enough
 * cursor.cpp depends on FractionWrapper
 * backwards-compatible QString + QStringRef construction
 * let Q_NAMESPACE and Q_ENUM_NS depend on SCRIPT_INTERFACE
 * Ms::Direction must be Q_DECLARE_METATYPE
 * elide plugin-related headers from the build without SCRIPT_INTERFACE
 * supply matching ifdefs for pluginManager calls in main code

This is based on changes by @AntonioBL  and I merely made it rely on the SCRIPT_INTERFACE compilation option more (so it does not break anything when SCRIPT_INTERFACE is on — that is, by default), to make backporting this easier.

Add header defining DBL_MIN and DBL_MAX, too.

Tested to compile fine on Debian stable (9 “stretch”), Qt 5.7.","closed_by":{"login":"anatoly-os","id":18065034,"node_id":"MDQ6VXNlcjE4MDY1MDM0","avatar_url":"https://avatars.githubusercontent.com/u/18065034?v=4","gravatar_id":"","url":"https://api.github.com/users/anatoly-os","html_url":"https://github.com/anatoly-os","followers_url":"https://api.github.com/users/anatoly-os/followers","following_url":"https://api.github.com/users/anatoly-os/following{/other_user}","gists_url":"https://api.github.com/users/anatoly-os/gists{/gist_id}","starred_url":"https://api.github.com/users/anatoly-os/starred{/owner}{/repo}","subscriptions_url":"https://api.github.com/users/anatoly-os/subscriptions","organizations_url":"https://api.github.com/users/anatoly-os/orgs","repos_url":"https://api.github.com/users/anatoly-os/repos","events_url":"https://api.github.com/users/anatoly-os/events{/privacy}","received_events_url":"https://api.github.com/users/anatoly-os/received_events","type":"User","user_view_type":"public","site_admin":false},"reactions":{"url":"https://api.github.com/repos/musescore/MuseScore/issues/4565/reactions","total_count":0,"+1":0,"-1":0,"laugh":0,"hooray":0,"confused":0,"heart":0,"rocket":0,"eyes":0},"timeline_url":"https://api.github.com/repos/musescore/MuseScore/issues/4565/timeline","performed_via_github_app":null,"state_reason":null}
